title: Not syncing with Galaxy Watch
body:
The app is not syncing with Samsung Galaxy Watch anymore.

Actually the app is syncing but nothing is shown on the app’s screen.

And not only that. It erases the workout log from the watch !!!

After the suggestion of Samsung to send a report from within the app. I realized that even that option does not work.

I reinstalled the app, and the watch started to sync again.

...but of course I lost all my history.

(Samsung suggests backing up data to Samsung’s sites. But this is not an option for people considering privacy as something important.
Samsung should provide an option to backup data locally.)
